treatment_summary: The patient has prediabetes with obesity and hypertension. NICE NG28 (2024 update) recommends Metformin MR plus an SGLT2‑inhibitor as first‑line therapy. After confirming eGFR ≥45 and absence of recurrent UTIs/DKA, start Metformin MR 500 mg daily and Empagliflozin 10 mg daily, titrating Metformin to 500 mg BID as tolerated. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, HbA1c (3‑month), BP and orthostatic symptoms. Because the patient’s BP is already low on three antihypertensives, consider reducing or stopping hydrochlorothiazide after review. Continue lisinopril and amlodipine for hypertension control. Provide structured lifestyle education (DESMOND/X‑PERT), aim for 5‑10 % weight loss, 150 min/week exercise, and address anemia work‑up.
